### RequiredMark

> The visible marker of a required field, text from messages. Hidden from assistive technology:
the control announces "required" itself. Use it when a field cannot use `Label`
(for example inside a `Checkbox` label).

Shared building blocks that make every form control (`Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Checkbox`, `CheckboxGroup`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`) look and behave the same: the same label, description and error styles, the same spacing, the same required marker, the same disabled treatment and the same validation timing. Tickets: ARCH-008, ARCH-009, part of GAP-003.

Most code never imports from `Field` directly: use the ready-made controls. Use the pieces when you compose a field that has no ready-made component yet (for example a custom picker built on a React Aria field).

- Import: `import { RequiredMark } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Field/Field.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Field`): Anatomy, ErrorsAfterSaveAttempt, RealtimeValidation

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ requiredMark: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance (`requiredMark`). |

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Field: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `requiredMark` | `*` | Visible marker after the label of a required field. Hidden from assistive technology. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-bg`, `--ds-control-h-lg`, `--ds-control-h-md`, `--ds-control-h-sm`, `--ds-danger`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-field-gap`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-focus-ring-danger`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-md`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-surface`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-weight-medium`

#### Exports

| Export                                 | What it is                                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Label`                                | React Aria `Label` with the field label style (13/18, medium). `isRequired` appends the required marker.                                                         |
| `Description`                          | React Aria `Text slot="description"`, 13/18 in `--ds-text-3`. Linked to the control with `aria-describedby`.                                                     |
| `FieldError`                           | React Aria `FieldError`: renders only while the field is invalid and the error is displayed. The message is in a `role="alert"` element. 13/18 in `--ds-danger`. |
| `FieldMessages`                        | `Description` followed by `FieldError`. Every control renders it under its box.                                                                                  |
| `RequiredMark`                         | The marker alone, for fields whose label is not a `Label`.                                                                                                       |
| `FieldLabelingProps`, `WithLabel`      | Types. `FieldLabelingProps` makes "label, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`" mandatory. `WithLabel<P>` helps type stories.                                       |
| `FieldErrorMessage`, `FieldValidation` | Types for the `errorMessage` prop (a node or a function of the validation result).                                                                               |

#### Anatomy and spacing

```
Label                       13/18 medium, --ds-text
  gap: --ds-field-gap (6px)
Control box                 border --ds-line-control, radius md, height 32/40/48
  gap: --ds-field-gap
Description                 13/18, --ds-text-3
Error                       13/18, --ds-danger
```

The description stays visible when an error shows (the handoff replaced the hint with the error). Constraints such as "8 characters or more" remain useful while the user fixes the value, and both texts are linked to the control.

#### One state model (ARCH-009)

| State     | Look                                                                                                                       | Semantics                                          |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| Default   | `--ds-line-control` border, `--ds-bg` fill                                                                                 |                                                    |
| Hover     | Border brightens to `--ds-text-3`. The fill never changes, so the border stays at 3:1 or more.                             |                                                    |
| Focus     | Accent border and the 3px focus ring (`--ds-focus-ring`); forced-colors gets a system outline                              |                                                    |
| Invalid   | Danger border and danger focus ring                                                                                        | `aria-invalid`, error linked by `aria-describedby` |
| Read only | `--ds-surface` fill, same border                                                                                           | `readonly`; focusable, submitted with the form     |
| Disabled  | Label and control at `--ds-opacity-disabled`, dashed border, `--ds-surface` fill; description and error stay full strength | `disabled`; not focusable, not submitted           |
| Required  | Marker after the label                                                                                                     | `required` / `aria-required` on the control        |

Form-control borders use `--ds-line-control` and stay at 3:1 or better against the page in every state (WCAG 1.4.11). The suites assert this per state.

#### Required marker

`Label isRequired` appends the text of the `requiredMark` message (`*` by default) inside the label. The marker is `aria-hidden`: the control itself exposes "required", so announcing the marker too would repeat it. Override the text per instance (`messages={{ requiredMark: '(required)' }}`) or app-wide:

```tsx
<DSProvider locale="pt-BR" messages={{ Field: { requiredMark: '(obrigatório)' } }}>
```

#### Validation behavior: native (default), and why

React Aria fields validate in one of two modes:

- `validationBehavior="native"` (React Aria's default, kept here): the browser's constraint validation. Constraints such as `required`, `type`, `pattern` and `minLength` block submission. The error is **not displayed until the user tries to submit**; then focus moves to the first invalid field and the error appears. Custom `validate` rules report when the user commits the field (leaves it) and again on submit.
- `validationBehavior="aria"`: only ARIA attributes are set; nothing blocks submission, and the error follows every keystroke.

**Decision: `native` is the default for all fields.** It implements the product rule _errors appear only after a save attempt_ without extra code, it works without JavaScript hydration problems (the browser blocks the submit), it puts `required` on the real control and it moves focus to the first problem. `aria` suits fields that need live feedback (a username availability check, a counter): opt in per field with `validationBehavior="aria"`. A consumer that renders its own `Form` can set the mode for every field below it.

Rules for authors:

- Provide an `errorMessage` that says how to fix the problem ("Enter a complete email address."). Without one, React Aria shows the browser's own message, in the browser's language.
- To control `isInvalid` yourself (for example after a server response), pass `isInvalid` and `errorMessage`; the error shows at once.
- The error text is announced when it appears (`role="alert"`) and read again when focus lands on the field.
- Putting `<form>` in the page is enough; no wrapper component is required.

#### Accessibility

- Every control needs an accessible name: `label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. The types enforce it; a development warning covers untyped callers.
- `Description` and `FieldError` are linked with `aria-describedby`; the order is description, then error.
- Disabled fields are exempt from contrast requirements; everything else meets 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for borders.

#### Related components

- Used by: Checkbox, Switch

### Select

> A single-choice dropdown built on React Aria `Select`: a button that opens a listbox in a
popover. Keyboard: Enter, Space or the arrow keys open it; typing selects by prefix (typeahead);
Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger. A hidden native `<select>` carries `name` and
the value into form submission and browser autofill.

Use it for 4 or more options; for 2 to 4 prefer `RadioGroup`.

Single-choice dropdown: a button that opens a listbox in a popover. Built on React Aria `Select` (`Button`, `SelectValue`, `Popover`, `ListBox`). A hidden native `<select>` carries `name` and the value into form submission and autofill. Shared field behavior is in [Field](../Field/Field.md).

- Import: `import { Select } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Select/Select.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Select`): Default, KeyboardAndTypeahead, EscapeClosesAndRestoresFocus, WithSelection, WithDescription, Required, Invalid, Disabled, Sizes, DisabledOptions, Sections, LongLabels

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly (SelectOption \| SelectGroup)[]` | yes |  | The options, or groups of options. Keep the order you want users to see (see Select.md). |
| `value` | `string \| null` |  |  | The selected `value`; `null` means nothing is selected. Pair with `onChange`. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` |  |  | The initially selected `value` when uncontrolled. |
| `onChange` | `((value: string \| null) => void)` |  |  | Called with the new `value`. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Helper text under the control. Linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| `errorMessage` | `FieldErrorMessage` |  |  | Error text, shown while the field is invalid and the error is displayed. See `Input`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  | Trigger text while nothing is selected. Default from messages: "Select an option". |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | `'md'` | Control height: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (default), `lg` 48px. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `popoverClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the popover that holds the options. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ placeholder: string; } & { requiredMark: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance: `placeholder`, `requiredMark`. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `AriaSelectProps` (react-aria): `autoComplete`, `form`, `name`
- From `CollectionBase` (@react-types/shared): `disabledKeys`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `DOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `FocusableDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `excludeFromTabOrder`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `InputBase` (@react-types/shared): `isDisabled`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `RACValidation` (react-aria-components): `validationBehavior`
- From `SelectProps` (react-stately): `allowsEmptyCollection`, `defaultOpen`, `isOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `shouldCloseOnSelect`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `Validation` (@react-types/shared): `isInvalid`, `isRequired`, `validate`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Select: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholder` | `Select an option` | Shown in the trigger while nothing is selected. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-field-control-padding-inline`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-item-h`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-select-popover-max-height`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-tracking-caption`, `--ds-z-dropdown`

#### When to use

- A choice from 4 or more options.

#### When not to use

- 2 to 4 options that users compare: `RadioGroup` (or a segmented control).
- Typing to filter a long list: `ComboBox` (planned).
- Several selections: `CheckboxGroup`.

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                            | Notes                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`, `description`, `errorMessage`          | As in `Input`.                                                                                      |
| `options`                                       | `SelectOption[]` (`value`, `label`, `isDisabled`) or groups `{ id, label, options }`, mixed freely. |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)`    | The selected option `value`; `null` means nothing selected. `onChange` receives `string \| null`.   |
| `placeholder`                                   | Trigger text while empty. Default from messages: "Select an option" (pt-BR "Selecione uma opção").  |
| `size`                                          | `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (default), `lg` 48px.                                                          |
| `name`, `isRequired`, `isInvalid`, `isDisabled` | Standard. `name` is submitted through the hidden `<select>`.                                        |
| `popoverClassName`, `className`, `ref`          | Styling hooks; `ref` is the field root.                                                             |
| `messages`                                      | `placeholder`, `requiredMark`.                                                                      |

Option order is yours: the component never reorders. The product rule that lists are alphabetical by default applies to what you pass in: use `sortByText(options, (o) => o.label, locale)` from `@loui/ds` (locale- and accent-aware) unless the order carries meaning (sizes, steps).

#### Anatomy and styling

- Trigger: the same box as `Input` (`--ds-line-control` border, focus ring, no hover fill), with a chevron.
- Popover: raised surface, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, radius `lg`, layer `--ds-z-dropdown`, at least as wide as the trigger, scrolls above `--ds-select-popover-max-height`.
- Option: `--ds-item-h` (36px) tall, hover and keyboard focus use `--ds-surface-hover`, the selected option shows a check (`Icon`), disabled options use the shared opacity.
- Section captions are mono, uppercase by CSS, in `--ds-text-2` (`--ds-text-3` fails contrast on the raised surface).

#### Accessibility and keyboard

| Key                                      | Behavior                                                       |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Enter`, `Space`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowUp` | Open the list and focus the selected (or first/last) option    |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp`                  | Next / previous enabled option                                 |
| `Home` / `End`                           | First / last option                                            |
| Letters                                  | Typeahead: focus the option starting with what you type        |
| `Enter` / `Space`                        | Select the focused option, close, focus returns to the trigger |
| `Escape`                                 | Close without changing; focus returns to the trigger           |
| Typing on the closed trigger             | Selects by prefix without opening                              |

The trigger is a `button` with `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, named by the label and described by the description and error. Options are `role="option"` with `aria-selected`; sections are `role="group"` named by their caption; disabled options have `aria-disabled`.

#### Example

```tsx
<Select
  label="Region"
  name="region"
  options={[
    { value: 'eu', label: 'EU: Frankfurt' },
    { value: 'us', label: 'US: Virginia' },
  ]}
  isRequired
  errorMessage="Choose a region."
/>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see RadioGroup: 2 to 4 options that users compare: `RadioGroup` (or a segmented control).
- Instead, see CheckboxGroup: Several selections: `CheckboxGroup`.
- Renders: FieldMessages, Icon, Label

### Skeleton

> A placeholder block in the shape of content that is still loading. It is always hidden
from assistive technology: mark the region that is loading with `aria-busy="true"` and
remove the attribute (and the skeletons) when the content arrives.

The `width` and `height` props are the only dynamic values in the library that reach the
DOM as custom properties on `style`, because arbitrary sizes cannot be tokens.

A placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading: a block, a circle, or a few text lines.

- Import: `import { Skeleton } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Skeleton/Skeleton.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Skeleton`): Default, Block, Circle, Lines, SingleLine, Pill, BusyRegion, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `string \| number` |  |  | Width: a number in px or any CSS length. Default `100%`. Ignored when `circle` is set (the circle is as wide as it is tall). |
| `height` | `string \| number` |  |  | Height of the block, or of each line: a number in px or any CSS length. Default `12px` (`--ds-skeleton-height`). |
| `circle` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Renders a circle, for an avatar. The diameter is `height`. |
| `lines` | `number` |  |  | Renders this many text lines; the last one is shorter. Takes precedence over `circle`. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-skeleton-height`, `--ds-skeleton-pulse-duration`, `--ds-skeleton-pulse-opacity`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-surface-hover`

#### When to use

- The layout of the content is known (a list of rows, a card, an avatar next to text) and the wait is short.
- Keep the page from jumping when the data arrives.

#### When not to use

- For an action in progress (saving, sending): use `Spinner` or a loading `Button`.
- For a measurable task: use `Progress`.
- When there is nothing to show after loading: use `EmptyState`.

#### Anatomy

```
span[aria-hidden="true"]  block | circle
span[aria-hidden="true"]  lines → n × span (last one is 60% wide)
```

#### Accessibility

- Every skeleton is `aria-hidden="true"`: it is decoration and has no text.
- **Mark the region that is loading with `aria-busy="true"`** and remove it, together with the skeletons, when the content arrives. This tells assistive technology the region is being updated. A skeleton on its own does not do this.
- If the wait is long, also expose a polite status ("Loading orders") near the region; skeletons never announce it.
- The pulse (opacity only) is switched off under `prefers-reduced-motion`. In forced-colors mode the placeholder gets a border because background colors are dropped.

#### Content rules

- Match the final layout: the same number of rows and similar widths, so nothing moves when the data arrives.
- Show at most one screenful of placeholders.

#### Examples

```tsx
<section aria-busy={isLoading} aria-label="Recent orders">
  {isLoading ? (
    <>
      <Skeleton circle height={28} />
      <Skeleton lines={3} />
    </>
  ) : (
    <OrderList orders={orders} />
  )}
</section>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Spinner: For an action in progress (saving, sending): use `Spinner` or a loading `Button`.
- Instead, see Button: For an action in progress (saving, sending): use `Spinner` or a loading `Button`.
- Instead, see Progress: For a measurable task: use `Progress`.
- Instead, see EmptyState: When there is nothing to show after loading: use `EmptyState`.

### Spinner

> An indeterminate loading ring that inherits the text color.

It is a `progressbar` without a value, not a live region, so many spinners on a screen do
not each interrupt a screen reader. For large areas prefer `Skeleton`. Under
`prefers-reduced-motion` the ring is static.

An indeterminate loading ring that inherits the text color. Small, quiet, and not a live region.

- Handoff source: `components/feedback/Spinner` (CMP-FBK-06).
- Built on: a plain element with `role="progressbar"`. A pending `Button` wires it as its busy label through React Aria.

- Import: `import { Spinner } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Spinner/Spinner.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Spinner`): Default, Sizes, WithLabel, DecorativeWithText, InheritsColor

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | `'md'` | Size token: `sm` 14px, `md` 18px (default), `lg` 20px. |
| `label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name. Defaults to the "Loading" message. Say what is loading when it helps ("Loading orders"). |
| `decorative` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Hide the spinner from assistive technology. Use it only when the surrounding UI already announces the busy state (visible status text, `aria-busy` region). Not needed inside a pending `Button`, which wires the spinner as its busy label. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ loading: string; }>` |  |  | Override the built-in messages for this instance. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Spinner: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | `Loading` |  |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-icon-lg`, `--ds-icon-md`, `--ds-icon-sm`, `--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-spinner-duration`, `--ds-spinner-stroke-width`

#### When to use

- Inside a pending `Button` (`isPending`), which renders it for you.
- Next to a short status text for a small, bounded wait ("Saving changes").
- A single small area that is loading and has no better placeholder.

#### When not to use

- For large areas or page loads: use `Skeleton` so the layout does not jump.
- When you know the progress: use `Progress` with a value.
- As a decoration. It means "busy", so remove it when the work ends.

#### Anatomy

One element: a ring with an open top edge. Size comes from `--ds-icon-sm|md|lg`, thickness from `--ds-spinner-stroke-width`, rotation time from `--ds-spinner-duration`.

#### Accessibility

- `role="progressbar"` with no value (indeterminate) and an accessible name. It is **not** `role="status"` or `aria-live`: a screen reader does not announce every spinner when it mounts. One announcement strategy per screen: the button (`Button` announces pending and done) or a single status region you control.
- Decorative mode: `aria-hidden="true"`. Pair it with visible status text in a `role="status"` region, as in the `DecorativeWithText` story.
- Reduced motion: under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the ring does not rotate. It stays as a static open ring; the accessible name and the busy control state carry the meaning.
- Forced colors: the ring is drawn with `currentColor` borders, which follow the system text color.
- Color: inherits the text color, so it needs no extra contrast treatment beyond its container's.

#### Content rules

- The name is a short noun phrase in sentence case: "Loading", "Loading orders". No ellipsis, no exclamation mark.
- Default text comes from the `Spinner` message catalog (`en`: "Loading", `pt-BR`: "Carregando"). Override it per instance or through `DSProvider messages={{ Spinner: { loading: '...' } }}`.

#### Examples

```tsx
<Spinner />
<Spinner label="Loading orders" size="lg" />

<p role="status">
  <Spinner decorative size="sm" /> Saving changes
</p>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Skeleton: For large areas or page loads: use `Skeleton` so the layout does not jump.
- Instead, see Progress: When you know the progress: use `Progress` with a value.
- Used by: Button

### Switch

> An on/off setting that applies immediately. Renders a native checkbox with `role="switch"`
(so `name` / `value` take part in form submission), a 36x20 track and a 16px knob.

State props follow React Aria: `isSelected`, `defaultSelected` and `onChange(isSelected)`.
For a choice that is confirmed later with a Save button, prefer `Checkbox`.

An on/off setting that takes effect immediately. A native checkbox with `role="switch"`, a 36x20 track and a 16px knob. Built on React Aria `SwitchField` + `SwitchButton` (the non-deprecated pair that supports a description and an error outside the label). Shared field behavior is in [Field](../Field/Field.md).

- Import: `import { Switch } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Switch/Switch.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Switch`): Default, On, WithDescription, LabelAtEnd, Disabled, ReadOnly, Required, Invalid, LongLabel, WithoutVisibleLabel

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Secondary text under the label. Linked with `aria-describedby`, not part of the name. |
| `errorMessage` | `FieldErrorMessage` |  |  | Error text, shown while the switch is invalid and the error is displayed. |
| `labelPlacement` | `'start' \| 'end'` |  | `'start'` | Where the label sits relative to the track. `start` (default): text on the leading side, track on the trailing side, spread across the row, the settings-list layout. `end`: track first. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ requiredMark: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance (`requiredMark`). |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. Use `inputRef` for the `<input>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `AriaSwitchProps` (react-aria): `aria-controls`
- From `AriaValidationProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-errormessage`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `DOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `FocusableDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `excludeFromTabOrder`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `InputBase` (@react-types/shared): `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`
- From `InputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `form`, `name`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `PressEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onClick`, `onPress`, `onPressChange`, `onPressEnd`, `onPressStart`, `onPressUp`
- From `RACValidation` (react-aria-components): `validationBehavior`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `SwitchFieldProps` (react-aria-components): `inputRef`
- From `ToggleProps` (react-stately): `value`
- From `ToggleStateOptions` (react-stately): `defaultSelected`, `isSelected`, `onChange`
- From `Validation` (@react-types/shared): `isInvalid`, `isRequired`, `validate`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-focus-ring-danger`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-switch-knob-offset`, `--ds-switch-knob-size`, `--ds-switch-track-height`, `--ds-switch-track-width`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-3`

#### When to use

- Settings that apply as soon as they change ("Email notifications"), with the state obvious from the label.

#### When not to use

- Choices confirmed later with a Save button or submitted as an agreement: `Checkbox`.
- One of several options: `RadioGroup`.

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                                                  | Notes                                                                                                               |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`                                                               | Visible label. Without it pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` (renders only the track).                          |
| `description`                                                         | Secondary text under the label, linked by `aria-describedby`, not part of the name.                                 |
| `labelPlacement`                                                      | `start` (default): text on the leading side, track on the trailing side, spread across the row. `end`: track first. |
| `isSelected` / `defaultSelected` / `onChange(isSelected)`             | React Aria naming.                                                                                                  |
| `name`, `value`                                                       | Submitted with the form while on (`value` defaults to `on`).                                                        |
| `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`, `isRequired`, `isInvalid`, `errorMessage` | Standard states.                                                                                                    |
| `inputRef` / `ref`                                                    | `inputRef` is the `<input>`, `ref` the field root.                                                                  |

#### Look

- Off: track in `--ds-line-control` (3:1 or better against the page, also on hover); on: `--ds-accent`. The knob uses `--ds-text` and moves with `inset-inline-start`, so it mirrors in right-to-left.
- Sizes come from component tokens: `--ds-switch-track-width`, `--ds-switch-track-height`, `--ds-switch-knob-size`, `--ds-switch-knob-offset`.
- The row is at least as tall as the track and the whole row is the click target, with one toggle per click.
- Reduced motion: transitions are removed by the base layer.
- Forced colors: the track gets a system border and a `Highlight` fill when on; the knob uses `CanvasText`.

#### Accessibility

- `Space` toggles the focused switch. `Enter` does not toggle (it submits the form, as for any native checkbox).
- Announced as "switch, on/off", named by the label only; the description is `aria-describedby`.
- State is conveyed by position and by color, and by the announced state.

#### Example

```tsx
<Switch label="Email notifications" description="A summary every morning." defaultSelected />
<Switch label="Dark mode" labelPlacement="end" name="theme" value="dark" />
<Switch aria-label="Enable sync" />
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Checkbox: Choices confirmed later with a Save button or submitted as an agreement: `Checkbox`.
- Instead, see RadioGroup: One of several options: `RadioGroup`.
- Renders: FieldMessages, RequiredMark

### Tag

> A mono outlined label for versions, SKUs and filters. Standalone it is static text (with an
optional remove button); inside a `TagGroup` it is a keyboard-navigable item that can be
removed with Backspace or Delete.

A mono outlined label for versions, SKUs and filters. `Tag` is static text on its own (with an optional remove button); inside a `TagGroup` it is an item with keyboard navigation, selection and removal. `TagGroup` is built on React Aria `TagGroup`, `TagList` and `Tag`.

- Import: `import { Tag } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Tag/Tag.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Tag`): Default, Removable, Disabled, LongText, RightToLeft, RemovableGroupStory, GroupStatic, GroupSelectable, GroupWithDisabledTag, GroupEmpty

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | yes |  | The text of the tag. Plain text, or any node together with `textValue`. |
| `textValue` | `string` |  |  | Plain-text version of the tag. Required when `children` is not a string: it names the tag for screen readers and is used in the name of the remove button ("Remove {textValue}"). |
| `id` | `Key` |  |  | Inside a `TagGroup`: the key of the tag (used by `onRemove`, selection and `disabledKeys`). Outside a group: the DOM `id`. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` |  |  | Disables the tag (inside a group: keyboard removal and selection too). |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` |  |  | Standalone tag only: shows a remove button that calls this. Inside a `TagGroup` use the group's `onRemove` instead (it also enables Backspace and Delete on the focused tag). |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ remove: (label: string) => string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Tag: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `remove(label: string)` | `Remove {label}` | Name of the remove button of a tag: it includes the text of the tag. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-accent-soft`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-tag-height`, `--ds-tag-padding-inline`, `--ds-tag-remove-size`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-weight-medium`

#### When to use

- Show an attribute or identifier: `v2.4.0`, `ORD-1048`, `linen`.
- Show applied filters that the user can remove (`TagGroup` with `onRemove`).
- Let the user toggle filters (`TagGroup` with `selectionMode`).

#### When not to use

- For a status (Shipped, Failed): use `Badge`.
- For a command: use `Button`.
- For choosing one option from a list: use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.

#### Anatomy

```
TagGroup           (grid; optional visible label)
  Label
  TagList          (flex wrap)
    Tag            (row)
      text
      remove button  only when the group has onRemove (24x24 target)
```

#### Accessibility

- A group is a `grid` with one `row` per tag. Arrow keys move between tags (roving focus); the focused tag is the only one in the tab order.
- **Backspace and Delete remove the focused tag** (or all selected tags) when the group has `onRemove`. Keyboard users are told so by a description that React Aria adds to the focused tag.
- **The remove button is named "Remove {text}"** from the message catalog (pt-BR: "Remover {text}"), not just "Remove". The button is also a tab stop after its tag, and is a 24 by 24 pixel target (WCAG 2.5.8).
- After a removal, focus moves to a neighbouring tag (React Aria); handle the empty state with `renderEmptyState` and move focus to something sensible yourself if the whole group disappears.
- Selection is exposed as `aria-selected`, and shown with the accent border and tint (a permitted use of the accent). Selection is never signalled by color alone: the state is announced.
- A standalone `Tag` is plain text. With `onRemove` it contains a real `<button>` (Enter or Space); Backspace and Delete do nothing there because the tag itself is not focusable. Use a `TagGroup` when keyboard removal matters.
- Text is `--ds-text-2` on the page surface; disabled tags are exempt from contrast and carry `aria-disabled`.

#### Content rules

- Short, lowercase or code-like values are fine (`v2.4.0`, `ORD-1048`); filters use the user's own words.
- Write a `textValue` that reads well after "Remove": "Remove linen".

#### Examples

```tsx
<Tag>v2.4.0</Tag>

<TagGroup label="Fabric" onRemove={(keys) => setTags((t) => t.filter((x) => !keys.has(x)))}>
  {tags.map((tag) => <Tag key={tag} id={tag}>{tag}</Tag>)}
</TagGroup>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Badge: For a status (Shipped, Failed): use `Badge`.
- Instead, see Button: For a command: use `Button`.
- Instead, see Select: For choosing one option from a list: use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.
- Instead, see RadioGroup: For choosing one option from a list: use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.
- Renders: Icon

### TagGroup

> A group of tags with one tab stop and arrow-key navigation. With `onRemove`, Backspace and
Delete remove the focused tag (or the selected tags) and every tag gets a remove button.
Built on React Aria `TagGroup`.

A mono outlined label for versions, SKUs and filters. `Tag` is static text on its own (with an optional remove button); inside a `TagGroup` it is an item with keyboard navigation, selection and removal. `TagGroup` is built on React Aria `TagGroup`, `TagList` and `Tag`.

- Import: `import { TagGroup } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Tag/Tag.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Tag`): Default, Removable, Disabled, LongText, RightToLeft, RemovableGroupStory, GroupStatic, GroupSelectable, GroupWithDisabledTag, GroupEmpty

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode \| ((item: T) => ReactNode)` | yes |  | Static `Tag` children, or a render function when `items` is given. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label of the group. Without it, give the group an `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. |
| `onRemove` | `(keys: Set<Key>) => void` |  |  | Called with the keys of the tags to remove (Backspace, Delete or the remove button). Makes the tags removable. |
| `items` | `Iterable<T>` |  |  | Data for the render function. Each item needs an `id` (or pass `id` to the rendered `Tag`). |
| `renderEmptyState` | `() => ReactNode` |  |  | Content shown when there are no tags (for example "No filters applied"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |  |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`
- From `AriaTagGroupProps` (react-aria): `escapeKeyBehavior`, `selectionBehavior`, `shouldSelectOnPressUp`
- From `CollectionBase` (@react-types/shared): `disabledKeys`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `GridListProps` (react-aria): `onAction`
- From `MultipleSelection` (@react-types/shared): `defaultSelectedKeys`, `disallowEmptySelection`, `onSelectionChange`, `selectedKeys`, `selectionMode`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-accent-soft`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-tag-height`, `--ds-tag-padding-inline`, `--ds-tag-remove-size`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-weight-medium`

#### When to use

- Show an attribute or identifier: `v2.4.0`, `ORD-1048`, `linen`.
- Show applied filters that the user can remove (`TagGroup` with `onRemove`).
- Let the user toggle filters (`TagGroup` with `selectionMode`).

#### When not to use

- For a command: use `Button`.
- For choosing one option from a list: use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.

#### Anatomy

```

  Label
  TagList          (flex wrap)
    Tag            (row)
      text
      remove button  only when the group has onRemove (24x24 target)
```

#### Accessibility

- A group is a `grid` with one `row` per tag. Arrow keys move between tags (roving focus); the focused tag is the only one in the tab order.

### Textarea

> Multi-line text field built on React Aria `TextField` + `TextArea`. Same contract as `Input`.

Multi-line text field. Same contract as [Input](../Input/Input.md) (label, description, error, states, validation timing from [Field](../Field/Field.md)), plus an aside, auto-growing height and a character count. Built on React Aria `TextField` + `TextArea`.

- Import: `import { Textarea } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Textarea/Textarea.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Textarea`): Default, WithDescription, WithAside, Required, Invalid, Disabled, ReadOnly, AutoGrow, WithCharacterCount, NoResize, LongLabel, Focused

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Helper text under the control. Linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| `errorMessage` | `FieldErrorMessage` |  |  | Error text, shown while the field is invalid and the error is displayed. See `Input`. |
| `aside` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Text on the label line, aligned to the end (for example "Optional" or "Markdown supported"). It is part of the field's description for assistive technology, not of its name. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  | Text shown while the field is empty. Never a substitute for the label. |
| `rows` | `number` |  | `3` | Visible lines before the user types. Default 3. |
| `resize` | `'none' \| 'vertical' \| 'horizontal' \| 'both'` |  | `'vertical'` | Whether the user can drag the corner to resize. Default `vertical`. Ignored with `autoGrow`. |
| `autoGrow` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Grows with its content instead of scrolling. |
| `showCount` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Shows "used / max" on the label line and announces the remaining characters politely once typing pauses. Needs `maxLength`. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `textareaClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the `<textarea>` element. |
| `textareaRef` | `Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>` |  |  | Ref to the `<textarea>` element. The `ref` prop points at the field root. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ count: (used: string, max: string) => string; remaining: (n: number) => string; over: (n: number) => string; } & { requiredMark: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance: `count`, `remaining`, `over`, `requiredMark`. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `AriaTextFieldProps` (react-aria): `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-controls`, `aria-haspopup`, `enterKeyHint`
- From `AriaValidationProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-errormessage`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `DOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `FocusableDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `excludeFromTabOrder`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `InputBase` (@react-types/shared): `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`
- From `InputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `form`, `name`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `RACValidation` (react-aria-components): `validationBehavior`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `TextFieldProps` (react-aria-components): `isInvalid`
- From `TextInputDOMEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBeforeInput`, `onCompositionEnd`, `onCompositionStart`, `onCompositionUpdate`, `onCopy`, `onCut`, `onInput`, `onPaste`, `onSelect`
- From `TextInputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoComplete`, `autoCorrect`, `maxLength`, `minLength`, `pattern`, `spellCheck`
- From `Validation` (@react-types/shared): `isRequired`, `validate`
- From `ValueBase` (@react-types/shared): `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `value`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Textarea: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count(used: string, max: string)` | `{used} / {max}` | Visible counter next to the label, for example "12 / 200". Arguments are already formatted. |
| `remaining(n: number)` | `2 characters remaining` | Polite announcement, made once typing pauses. |
| `over(n: number)` | `2 characters over the limit` | Announcement when a controlled value exceeds `maxLength`. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-danger`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-fs-meta`, `--ds-lh-meta`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-textarea-padding-block`, `--ds-textarea-padding-inline`

#### When to use

- Notes, comments, descriptions, messages longer than a line.

#### When not to use

- One line of text: `Input`.
- Rich text or Markdown editing: a dedicated editor.

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                         | Notes                                                                                                                    |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `label`, `description`, `errorMessage`       | As in `Input`.                                                                                                           |
| `aside`                                      | Text on the label line, aligned to the end ("Optional", "Markdown supported"). Part of the description, not of the name. |
| `rows`                                       | Visible lines. Default 3.                                                                                                |
| `resize`                                     | `none`, `vertical` (default), `horizontal`, `both`.                                                                      |
| `autoGrow`                                   | Grows with its content; the manual resize handle is off.                                                                 |
| `maxLength` + `showCount`                    | Shows "used / max" on the label line and announces the remaining characters politely.                                    |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)` | React Aria naming; `onChange` receives the string.                                                                       |
| `textareaRef` / `ref`                        | `textareaRef` is the `<textarea>`, `ref` the field root.                                                                 |
| `messages`                                   | `count`, `remaining`, `over`, `requiredMark`.                                                                            |

#### Character count

- The visible counter ("12 / 200", formatted for the locale) is `aria-hidden`: announcing it on every keystroke would drown the user.
- A separate visually hidden `role="status"` (polite) region announces "N characters remaining" once typing has paused for one second. It stays silent until the value changes, and says "N characters over the limit" when a controlled value exceeds `maxLength`.
- Plural forms and the pt-BR text come from `Textarea.messages.ts`. Override `count`, `remaining` and `over` per instance or via `DSProvider messages={{ Textarea: { ... } }}`.
- `showCount` has no effect without `maxLength`. The native `maxLength` stops typing at the limit.

#### Accessibility

- Native `<textarea>` named by its label; `aside` and `description` are in `aria-describedby` (description first, then aside).
- Keyboard: standard text editing; `Enter` inserts a newline; `Tab` leaves the field.
- Auto-grow keeps all content visible (no inner scrollbar), which helps zoom and reflow.

#### Example

```tsx
<Textarea label="Notes" aside="Optional" description="Plain text only." maxLength={500} showCount />
<Textarea label="Message" autoGrow rows={2} isRequired errorMessage="Write a message." />
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Input: One line of text: `Input`.
- Renders: FieldMessages, Label, VisuallyHidden

### VisuallyHidden

> Hides content visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.
Use it for text alternatives that sighted users do not need.

- Import: `import { VisuallyHidden } from '@loui/ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/VisuallyHidden/VisuallyHidden.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Primitives/VisuallyHidden`): Default, AsHeading

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `as` | `ElementType` |  | `span` | Element to render. Defaults to `span`. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Related components

- Used by: Alert, Kbd, Link, Textarea

---

## Hooks and utilities

> Hooks, locale-aware utilities and message helpers exported from `@loui/ds`. Money is an integer in minor units with an ISO 4217 code (ADR-0006).

### Hooks

#### useControllableState

Controlled/uncontrolled state for the `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange`
convention (AGENTS.md section 9). Thin wrapper over react-stately's `useControlledState`,
which also warns in development when a component switches between modes.

```tsx
const [value, setValue] = useControllableState({ value: props.value, defaultValue: props.defaultValue ?? '', onChange: props.onValueChange });
```

```ts
useControllableState<T>({ value, defaultValue, onChange, }: UseControllableStateOptions<T>): [T, (value: T) => void]
```

#### useDSLocale

Returns the active locale (BCP 47 tag) set by `DSProvider`; `en-US` without a provider.

```ts
useDSLocale(): string
```

#### useHotkey

Runs `handler` when a single key combo is pressed.

- `combo`: modifiers joined with `+` and one key, e.g. `Mod+K`, `Shift+/`, `Alt+N`, `Escape`.
  `Mod` is Command on macOS and Control elsewhere.
- Ignores events from editable fields (unless `allowInEditable`), IME composition,
  key auto-repeat (unless `allowRepeat`) and events another handler already prevented.

This is deliberately small. A shortcut registry with conflict detection and a help
overlay is a separate task (GAP-004).

```ts
useHotkey(combo: string, handler: (event: KeyboardEvent) => void, { enabled, scope, allowInEditable, allowRepeat, preventDefault, platform, }?: UseHotkeyOptions): void
```

#### useMediaQuery

Subscribes to a CSS media query. SSR-safe: on the server (and during hydration)
it returns `defaultValue` (`false` unless given), then the real value after hydration.

Prefer CSS media queries for styling; use this only when behavior (not appearance) depends on the query.

```ts
useMediaQuery(query: string, defaultValue?: boolean): boolean
```

#### useMessages

Returns a component's messages for the active locale.

```ts
useMessages<M extends MessageSet>(componentKey: string, catalog: MessageCatalog<M>, overrides?: MessageOverrides): M
```

#### usePrefersReducedMotion

True when the user asks the OS for reduced motion (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`).

```ts
usePrefersReducedMotion(): boolean
```

### Utilities and constants

#### compareText

Compares two strings alphabetically for `locale`; usable as an `Array.prototype.sort` comparator.

```ts
compareText(a: string, b: string, locale: string): number
```

#### contrastRatio

WCAG contrast ratio between two hex colors, from `1` (identical) to `21` (black on white). Order does not matter.

```ts
contrastRatio(a: string, b: string): number
```

#### createTextCollator

Collator for alphabetical order as the product requires (AGENTS.md section 5, rule 5b):
accent- and case-insensitive (`sensitivity: 'base'`) with natural number order
(`numeric: true`, so `Item 2` sorts before `Item 10`). The instance is shared
and cached per locale; do not mutate it.

```ts
createTextCollator(locale: string): Intl.Collator
```

#### daysBetween

Whole days from `isoA` to `isoB` (positive when `isoB` is later). Uses UTC
date math, so daylight-saving changes cannot produce 23- or 25-hour "days".
Invalid input throws in development and returns `NaN` in production.

```ts
daysBetween(isoA: ISODate, isoB: ISODate): number
```

#### DEFAULT_LOCALE

Default locale.

```ts
"en-US" | "pt-BR"
```

#### defineMessages

Declares a component's catalog. Identity function that type-checks that
`pt-BR` has exactly the same keys and signatures as `en`.

```ts
defineMessages<M extends MessageSet>(catalog: { readonly en: M; readonly "pt-BR": NoInfer<M>; readonly [locale: string]: NoInfer<M> | undefined; }): MessageCatalog<M>
```

#### dueStatus

Urgency of a due date: overdue (`< 0` days) is `danger`, due within a week
(`0` to `7`) is `warning`, later is `neutral`. The visible text always comes
from messages (color is never the only signal, AGENTS.md section 5).

```ts
dueStatus(dueISO: ISODate, todayISO: ISODate): DueStatus
```

#### formatCurrency

Formats money held as an integer in minor units (ADR-0006):
`formatCurrency(123456, 'USD', 'en-US')` is `$1,234.56`.

The amount is passed to `Intl` as an exact decimal string, so there is no
floating-point drift. Non-integer or unsafe amounts throw in development
(a sign of a unit bug at the call site) and are rounded in production.

```ts
formatCurrency(minorUnits: number, currency: string, locale: string, options?: FormatCurrencyOptions): string
```

#### formatDate

Formats an ISO date for `locale`. Formatting happens in UTC, so the day never
shifts with the viewer's time zone. Invalid input throws in development and
is returned unchanged in production.

`formatDate('2026-10-31', 'en-US', 'medium')` is `Oct 31, 2026`.

```ts
formatDate(iso: ISODate, locale: string, style?: DateStyle): string
```

#### formatNumber

Formats a decimal number for `locale` (`1234.5` becomes `1,234.5` in `en-US`).

```ts
formatNumber(value: number, locale: string, options?: FormatNumberOptions): string
```

#### formatPercent

Formats a ratio as a percentage: `0.256` becomes `26%` in `en-US`.
Pass `maximumFractionDigits` for more precision.

```ts
formatPercent(ratio: number, locale: string, options?: Omit<FormatNumberOptions, "unit" | "unitDisplay">): string
```

#### formatRelativeDays

Relative day label from `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` with `numeric: 'auto'`:
`-1` is `yesterday`, `0` is `today`, `1` is `tomorrow`, `3` is `in 3 days`.
`days` must be an integer (throws in development, rounded in production).

```ts
formatRelativeDays(days: number, locale: string): string
```

#### getCurrencyDigits

Number of minor-unit digits of a currency (2 for USD/BRL, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD),
read from `Intl` so we never keep our own table.

```ts
getCurrencyDigits(currency: string, locale: string): number
```

#### getInitials

Initials of a person's name: the first letter of the first and of the last word
(`Ana Maria da Silva` gives `AS`), or one letter for a single word. Uses `Intl.Segmenter`,
so combined characters stay whole, and upper-cases with the locale rules (`i` in `tr`).

```ts
getInitials(name: string, locale: string): string
```

#### highlightMatch

Splits `text` into matched and unmatched segments for highlighting, ignoring case
and accents. The segments always concatenate back to `text` exactly, and a match
keeps any combining marks attached to its last letter. All occurrences are returned.

`highlightMatch('Crème brûlée', 'creme')` gives `[{ text: 'Crème', match: true }, { text: ' brûlée', match: false }]`.

```ts
highlightMatch(text: string, query: string): HighlightSegment[]
```

#### iconNames

Kebab-case names of the curated set with the use each icon is meant for. Source of the
allow-list in the component manifest; keep it in sync with the exports above (tested).

```ts
{ readonly 'arrow-down': "Descending sort, move down"; readonly 'arrow-left': "Back, previous page"; readonly 'arrow-right': "Forward, next step"; readonly 'arrow-up': "Ascending sort, move up"; readonly calendar: "Date fields and date pickers"; readonly check: "Done, selected, checkbox mark"; readonly 'chevron-down': "Collapsed disclosure, select trigger, menu button"; readonly 'chevron-left': "Previous month or page (use the directional prop so it mirrors in RTL)"; readonly 'chevron-right': "Next month or page, submenu, breadcrumb separator (directional)"; readonly 'chevron-up': "Expanded disclosure"; readonly 'chevrons-up-down': "Sortable column, select trigger with many options"; readonly 'circle-alert': "Error and danger status"; readonly 'circle-check': "Success status"; readonly 'circle-x': "Failed status, clear input"; readonly ellipsis: "More actions (overflow menu)"; readonly 'external-link': "Link that opens in a new tab"; readonly info: "Neutral information status"; readonly loader: "Loading glyph (static); animated loading uses Spinner"; readonly minus: "Remove one, indeterminate checkbox"; readonly plus: "Add, create"; readonly search: "Search fields"; readonly star: "Rating, favorite"; readonly 'triangle-alert': "Warning status"; readonly x: "Close, dismiss, remove"; }
```

#### iconSet

The curated set by kebab-case name, for tooling and name-driven rendering.

```ts
{ readonly 'arrow-down': LucideIcon; readonly 'arrow-left': LucideIcon; readonly 'arrow-right': LucideIcon; readonly 'arrow-up': LucideIcon; readonly calendar: LucideIcon; readonly check: LucideIcon; readonly 'chevron-down': LucideIcon; readonly 'chevron-left': LucideIcon; readonly 'chevron-right': LucideIcon; readonly 'chevron-up': LucideIcon; readonly 'chevrons-up-down': LucideIcon; readonly 'circle-alert': LucideIcon; readonly 'circle-check': LucideIcon; readonly 'circle-x': LucideIcon; readonly ellipsis: LucideIcon; readonly 'external-link': LucideIcon; readonly info: LucideIcon; readonly loader: LucideIcon; readonly minus: LucideIcon; readonly plus: LucideIcon; readonly search: LucideIcon; readonly star: LucideIcon; readonly 'triangle-alert': LucideIcon; readonly x: LucideIcon; }
```

#### isISODate

True if `value` is a real calendar date written as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

```ts
isISODate(value: string): value is ISODate
```

#### matchesSearch

True when `text` contains `query`, ignoring case and accents. An empty query matches everything.

```ts
matchesSearch(text: string, query: string): boolean
```

#### normalizeSearch

Normalizes text for accent- and case-insensitive search: `Café` and `cafe` both
become `cafe`. Works per code point so it stays index-aligned with `highlightMatch`.

```ts
normalizeSearch(text: string): string
```

#### parseCurrencyInput

Parses what the user typed in a currency field into integer minor units, using
the digits-only typing model: every digit shifts in from the right, and any
other character (separators, symbols, spaces, a sign) is ignored. Typing
`1`, `2`, `3` into a USD field yields `1`, `12`, `123`, shown as `$0.01`,
`$0.12`, `$1.23`. Digits of the locale's numbering system (e.g. Arabic-Indic)
and full-width digits count as digits. Empty input is `0`. Input longer than
15 digits is cut, so the result is always a safe integer.

`currency` is validated through `Intl` (throws `RangeError` for an invalid code).
Pasting `12` into a USD field means `$0.12` by this model; callers that want
to accept pasted decimals must handle paste before calling this function.

```ts
parseCurrencyInput(text: string, currency: string, locale: string): number
```

#### plural

Picks a plural form for `count` using `Intl.PluralRules`.
Call it from catalog functions, passing that catalog's own locale:
`selected: (n: number) => plural('en', n, { one: '1 selected', other: `${n} selected` })`.

```ts
plural(locale: string, count: number, forms: PluralForms): string
```

#### readableTextOn

Which text color is more readable on a background color: `'light'` (white-ish
text, for dark backgrounds) or `'dark'`. Picks whichever of white or black has
the higher WCAG contrast, replacing the handoff's 0.299/0.587/0.114 shortcut.

```ts
readableTextOn(backgroundHex: string): "light" | "dark"
```

#### relativeLuminance

WCAG 2.x relative luminance of a hex color: `0` (black) to `1` (white).
Accepts `#rgb` and `#rrggbb`. Invalid colors throw in development and count as black in production.

```ts
relativeLuminance(hex: string): number
```

#### sortByText

Returns a new array sorted alphabetically by `getText(item)`. Stable: items whose
text compares equal (for example `Ana` and `ana`, or `é` and `e`) keep their input order.

```ts
sortByText<T>(items: readonly T[], getText: (item: T) => string, locale: string): T[]
```

#### SUPPORTED_LOCALES

Locales that ship with built-in message catalogs (ADR-0005).

```ts
readonly ["en-US", "pt-BR"]
```

#### toISODate

Converts a `Date` to `YYYY-MM-DD` using its **local** calendar day (what the
user sees on their clock). Pass `{ utc: true }` to use the UTC day instead.
Invalid dates and years outside 0000-9999 throw in development and give `''` in production.

```ts
toISODate(date: Date, options?: { utc?: boolean; }): ISODate
```

#### warnDeprecated

Logs a deprecation warning once per `name`. Development only: a no-op in
production builds and on the server-side of production. Call it from the
deprecated component's body or module, passing what to use instead.

`warnDeprecated('OldButton', 'Use Button with variant="ghost" instead.')`

```ts
warnDeprecated(name: string, message: string): void
```

### Icons

Bundled Lucide icons, exported with an `Icon` suffix. Pass one to `Icon`, `IconButton` or a `leading`/`trailing` slot. Decorative unless labelled.

`ArrowDownIcon`, `ArrowLeftIcon`, `ArrowRightIcon`, `ArrowUpIcon`, `CalendarIcon`, `CheckIcon`, `ChevronDownIcon`, `ChevronLeftIcon`, `ChevronRightIcon`, `ChevronsUpDownIcon`, `ChevronUpIcon`, `CircleAlertIcon`, `CircleCheckIcon`, `CircleXIcon`, `EllipsisIcon`, `ExternalLinkIcon`, `InfoIcon`, `LoaderIcon`, `MinusIcon`, `PlusIcon`, `SearchIcon`, `StarIcon`, `TriangleAlertIcon`, `XIcon`
